ZMB.note: Document is about tax payment, not e-procurement.
States nothing on the central bank's mandate, licensing, switch or PAPSS.
States nothing on consumer rules or redress.
Payments to government only, no G2P.
Tax payment channels only; no retail wallet service or interoperability stated.

facts.fact: ZRA says it has digitalised its payment processes, with about 99 percent of payments performed electronically, through platforms including TaxOnApp, TaxOnPhone, TaxOnline Portal and WhatsApp Payment.
ZRA says that in December 2023 it implemented the Integrated Payment System, introducing customs payments on mobile platforms alongside its tax payment platforms.
ZRA's Oliver Nzala says about 99 percent of payments were performed electronically, and electronic adoption reached 80 percent after working with all banks and three mobile network providers by 2020.

systems.platform: TaxOnApp, TaxOnPhone, Customs Portal, TaxOnline Portal, WhatsApp Payment
